d: We are seeking a Senior Accountant to join our team. The Senior Accountant is responsible for overseeing daily accounting operations, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial records, and maintaining compliance with applicable accounting standards, financial regulations, and tax requirements.
q: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
Professional certifications such as SOCPA, CPA, or CMA are preferred .
Good knowledge of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and applicable accounting standards in Saudi Arabia.
Prior experience 4-6 years in accounting or in similar role
Strong knowledge of financial reporting and financial statement analysis.
Knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
Effective communication skills verbal and written (In English & Arabic).
r: li
Record and review daily journal entries, ensuring accurate account classification and compliance with the approved chart of accounts and accounting policies.
li
Perform and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities, and prepare financial statements and management reports.
li
Prepare and review bank reconciliations, customer and supplier account reconciliations, and clearing account reconciliations, ensuring timely resolution of outstanding items.
li
Monitor accounts receivable and accounts payable, and review invoices, payment certificates, and financial claims prior to approval.
li
Record and monitor revenues and costs associated with company projects and contracts, and analyze project costs and profitability.
li
Prepare and review tax returns, including Value Added Tax (VAT) and Withholding Tax, and coordinate with the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) to ensure regulatory compliance.
li
Maintain the fixed asset register, calculate periodic depreciation, and monitor prepaid expenses and accrued liabilities.
li
Participate in preparing annual budgets and financial forecasts, analyze actual versus budgeted performance, and provide recommendations to address variances.
li
Coordinate with external auditors and provide the required financial records, supporting documents, and explanations during audit engagements.
li
Supervise accounting staff, review their work and deliverables, and provide technical guidance and support to ensure accuracy and efficiency.
li
Contribute to developing and improving financial and accounting policies and procedures, while strengthening internal controls and financial governance.
